## Rows

| dice | result | effect | severity | notes |

| 11-13 | Wild Shot | Your missile goes wide and is lost or lodged somewhere useless. Recovering it is impossible in the moment. | Low |  |
| 14-16 | Poor Draw | Your grip, draw, or throw is off from the start. The attack leaves you off-balance and exposed. | Low |  |
| 21-23 | Snapped String | Your bowstring frays or snaps under strain. The weapon cannot be used again until repaired. | Moderate |  |
| 24-26 | Slipped Missile | An arrow, stone, or knife slips from your hand at the wrong instant. Your attack fails and you lose your next opening. | Moderate |  |
| 31-33 | Exposed Shooter | Your shot reveals your exact position. Enemies immediately know where you are. | Moderate |  |

| 44-46 | Obstructed Line | You fire through brush, cover, or a moving gap and your shot ricochets or shatters. A nearby ally or object is put at risk. | High |  |
| 51-53 | Weapon Dropped | In the rush of combat, you drop your ranged weapon into mud, water, or hard ground. Recovering it costs your next fast action or more. | High |  |

| 61-63 | Backlash Shot | The shot goes disastrously wrong and leaves you open to a charge, fall, or counterattack. An enemy immediately closes with you. | Severe |  |
